## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `cce992bf300b96b0c2d4d3ec633e3f0315dbddbb`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md + `packages/spec/src/system/push-config.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/api/push-relay.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/api/push-delivery.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/system/push-device.zod.ts`, `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts#RegisterDeviceRequestSchema`, `packages/services/service-push/src/{push-plugin.ts,transports/apns.ts,transports/fcm.ts}`, `packages/services/service-messaging/src/{push-channel.ts,device-registry.ts,objects/user-device.object.ts}`, `docs/adr/0030-notification-platform-convergence.md`, `docs/adr/README.md`, `scripts/adr-index.mjs`, `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`, `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (signature rule), card #29817 (body + 4 comments), #29816 body, #29920 / #29041 / PR #29794 / PR #29886 state. All read at `origin/main` `1f6bc5aa`; no scoped file moved between the merge-base `6a4737ab` and `1f6bc5aa`. cloud#3519 is not readable from this session; the card body binds (1C 2A 3A 4B 5A 6B 7B, 2026-11-03).

### ① Derived judgments

- Net diff against main: one file, `docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md`, +22/−9. No accept-set moves, no public surface moves, no generated artifact, no changeset, no `ui/` path — verified on the file list and `git diff origin/main...cce992bf`. Right.
- Every `path#symbol` anchor the hunks add resolves in the live tree: `push-config.zod.ts#{PushVendorSchema,PushServiceConfigSchema,PushRelayTransportConfigSchema,PushDirectTransportConfigSchema}`, `push-relay.zod.ts#{PushRelayRequestSchema,PushRelayResponseSchema,PushRelayErrorResponseSchema,PushRelayPayloadSchema}`, `push-device.zod.ts#UserDeviceSchema`, `push-plugin.ts#PUSH_RELAY_NOT_SERVED_MESSAGE`, `push-channel.ts`. Right.
- `docs/adr/README.md` needs no edit: the index row's status summary is cut by `adr-index.mjs` before the amended text begins, and the status keyword stays `Draft` first; the `Superseded by` extraction reads an unchanged span. Right.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` with no changeset is correct: the one path is under `docs/adr/**`, which publishes nothing from any released package (AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist 3). `Clause-②: no (docs only, no spec shape moves)` is the right value — `CLAUSE2_VALUES` is `['yes','no']`, so the order's `n/a` would read malformed; `Metadata-protocol: none` is right (no key, value or default an author can write moves). `Check Changeset` concluded success on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

os-dev-report 6610622592, each deviation answered:
1. Clause-② `no` not `n/a`: correct, see ②.
2. No assignees / reviewer request at `pr_create`: a seat hand-over step, not a review matter.
3. No signature line on the `pr_create` body: not a defect. `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` (§ "#27113") carves `pr_create` out of the first-line rule by name ("a pull request body's first line is `Fixes #n` … the ruling is about posts, not pull request bodies"); the HTML-comment `signed:` trailer (`PR_BODY_TRAILER_SHAPE`) binds only a later seat rewrite through `issue_patch`. The body's line 3 is `Fixes #29817`, as that rule expects.
4. Commit trailer: the commit carries `Claude-Session:` + `Co-authored-by: Claude` (noreply address), the model-free pair AGENTS.md requires. Resolved.
5. cloud#3519 unreadable: same here; the card body binds, and the ADR cites the ruling as the card states it, attributing no decision to a single letter.
Open questions: none declared, none found. Out-of-scope finding 1 (stale `push-config.zod.ts` / `push-device.zod.ts` comments that still say ADR-0012 §6 routes the domestic vendors to alternate channel plugins) is real: once this ADR lands those docblocks cite the ADR for a reading it no longer holds. The card forbids code changes, so it stays out of this PR — escalate: the seat should file the follow-up card (or fold it into the `PushVendorSchema` widening card when it exists) rather than leave it "noted, not filed".

### ④ Design judgment

Held against `push-config.zod.ts`, `push-relay.zod.ts`, `push-plugin.ts`, `push-channel.ts`, `push-device.zod.ts`, #29816 and the card's ruling:
- Nothing unshipped is stated as shipped. The relay appears only as "decided, not yet served" (status line, §4 Status cell, §6.1 last bullet, each naming #29920); `PushServicePlugin` does throw `PUSH_RELAY_NOT_SERVED_MESSAGE` for any non-`direct` parse, `{}` included (`push-plugin.ts` init). Phase-2 vendors and E2EE are "decided and planned, no card yet", and #29816's body confirms both were left out on purpose (`PushVendorSchema` stays `apns | fcm`; `RegisterDeviceRequestSchema` gets no `pushKey`; `git grep pushKey` over `packages/spec/src` is empty). The direct transport sending `title`/`body` today matches `push-channel.ts`.
- Transport names, defaults, `vendor` enum and the direct narrowing match the schema exactly: `transport: 'relay' | 'direct'` discriminated union with `unionFallback`, `{}` → relay, a vendor block without `transport` → direct; relay block keys `transport` + optional https `endpoint` ("Absent: the production relay"), credentials refused by name; direct block `apns`/`fcm` optional with `requiredOneOf`, `endpoint` refused; `PushVendorSchema = z.enum(['apns','fcm'])`; `UserDeviceSchema.vendor: PushVendorSchema`. The wire (`token`, `vendor`, `payload`, `priority`; `ok`/`invalid`/`retry` in request order; 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`, 429 `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`/`QUOTA_EXCEEDED`), the ID-only payload (`data` + `text`; `title`/`body`/`subtitle`/`message`/`content` refused by name) and `PushDeliveryDataSchema`'s three members all match.
- Supersession: the 2026-11-03 `Amended (… #29041)` header is extended in place, not paralleled; `Draft` stays first and `Superseded by ADR-0030` stays. The extension names the passages it amends and each named passage quotes its old wording.
- Goals and Non-Goals are consistent with §1 TL;DR item 5, §6, §6.1, M3, risk 5 and the Decision list; no "plugin transports" / "alternate channel" / "channel plugins" wording survives outside quoted old text (grepped at head). The §6 `UserDeviceSchema` proposal block (wide `vendor` enum) and the §1 diagram's `sys_user_device (APNs/FCM tokens…)` are historical/phase-1-true and already covered by the #29041 note and the status line's `plugin-notification-push` reading.
- ADR-0030: its only push wording is `sys_user_device (push)` (L5 row) and `push (sys_user_device + APNs/FCM)` (item 3); the relay forwards to APNs/FCM, so neither contradicts, and "channels as plugins" there is about channels, which the ADR keeps. Unchanged, as the card requires.
- `cloud ADR-0008` is cited in the sanctioned `cloud ADR-NNNN` form.

Findings:
- **should-fix** (supersession bookkeeping): the status line's enumeration of amended passages omits three it changed — TL;DR item 2 and the Goals "Four built-in channels" bullet (both had `push (APNs + FCM)` and neither quotes it) and the new Non-Goals "System push in an air-gapped deployment" bullet — so "Each amended passage quotes the wording it replaces" is not true of the first two. Add the three to the list and quote `(APNs + FCM)` once.
- **should-fix** (precision): §6.1 last bullet says "every relay schema carries a `[PLANNED — not yet served]` marker"; `PushRelayPrioritySchema` and `PushRelayResultStatusSchema` (and the private binding-refusal enum) do not. Narrow to the object/request/response/error schemas, which do.
- nit: §6.1 "its one key is `endpoint`" — the relay block also has `transport`; "its one key besides `transport`" is exact.
No must-fix: no sentence states an unshipped thing as shipped, every schema claim matches the tree, and no wording conflicts with the ruling or ADR-0030.

CI on `cce992bf` (check-runs read at review, no local re-run): 22 of 24 non-skipped runs concluded `success`, among them `Check Changeset`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Type Check · workspace/source gates/debt ledger`, `Test UI`; none failed. Still running at this reading: `Test Core (1/8)` and `Type Check · consumer gates` — the landing waits on those two turning green as well as on the maintainer's hand (Tier H).

Read at `origin/main` `40fa4335`; no scoped file moved on `main` between the prior read (`1f6bc5aa`) and now.

- Should-fix 1 resolved: the status line now names TL;DR item 2 and the Goals "Four built-in channels" bullet among the amended passages and quotes their old wording once ("`push` (APNs + FCM)"), and each of the two passages now quotes it in place; the three passages that replace nothing (the Non-Goals air-gap bullet, §6.1, the Decision "Push transports" bullet) are listed as new. "Each amended passage quotes the wording it replaces" is now true of every hunk in the net diff: status line, TL;DR 2, Goals ×2, Non-Goals ×2, §4 push row, §6 domestic bullet, §6.1, M3, risk 5, Decision. Right.
- Should-fix 2 resolved against the live tree: `push-relay.zod.ts` carries exactly seven `[PLANNED — not yet served]` describes, on `PushRelayPayloadSchema`, `PushRelayDeliverySchema`, `PushRelayRequestSchema`, `PushRelayResultSchema`, `PushRelayResponseSchema`, `PushRelayErrorSchema`, `PushRelayErrorResponseSchema` (the eighth match in the file is the module docblock); `PushRelayPrioritySchema` and `PushRelayResultStatusSchema` carry none; `PushRelayTransportConfigSchema` in `push-config.zod.ts` carries one. The §6.1 sentence now matches that count by name. Right.
- Nit 3 resolved: "beside `transport`, its only key is `endpoint`" matches the relay block's two keys (`transport` literal with default, optional https `endpoint`); `url`/`relayUrl` are aliases, not keys. Right.
- Nothing is stated as shipped that `main` does not ship: the new wording only re-enumerates which schemas carry the planned marker and reaffirms that `PushServicePlugin` refuses a relay block until #29920. No regression elsewhere in the prior record: anchors still resolve, `PushVendorSchema` stays `apns | fcm`, ADR-0030 and `docs/adr/README.md` untouched.
- The commit stays in the one file; no accept-set, public surface, generated artifact, changeset or `ui/` path. Trailers are the model-free `Claude-Session:` + `Co-authored-by: Claude` pair.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from the prior record: docs-only under `docs/adr/**`, nothing published moves; `skip-changeset` label present, no changeset. `Check Changeset` is `skipped` on this head (path-filtered; it was `success` on `cce992bf`) — no verdict to carry, nothing to fix.

### ③ Boundary flags

No new deviation declared on the PR since comment 6610988758 (no later comments). Escalation carried forward unchanged: `packages/spec/src/system/push-config.zod.ts` (the `PushVendorSchema` docblock, "ADR-0012 §6 plugs the domestic Android vendors in as alternate channel implementations") and `packages/spec/src/system/push-device.zod.ts` (header and the "Narrowed from ADR-0012 §6" paragraph) still cite §6 for a reading this ADR no longer holds. The card forbids code changes; the seat files the follow-up card (or folds it into the `PushVendorSchema` widening card when it exists).

### ④ Design judgment

The delta tightens three sentences and changes no decision, rule or default; the amendment's supersession bookkeeping is now complete and the schema census is exact. One remaining nit, not blocking: §6.1 says "the two enums there ... carry none" — a third, non-exported enum (`PushRelayBindingRefusalSchema`) also carries none; "the two exported enums" would be exact. No must-fix, no should-fix.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：ADR-0012（通知平台）按 cloud#3519 的裁决改写推送决定。推送默认走我们托管的推送中继，白标应用才直连 APNs/FCM。设备表上的 `vendor` 只是令牌类型，中继按它路由，不是插件边界。国内厂商（HMS/荣耀、小米、OPPO、vivo）在第二阶段由同一个中继承接。中继永远拿不到通知明文：第一阶段只传 ID，第二阶段用设备密钥端到端加密。离线（air-gap）部署没有系统推送，只有站内收件箱。
- 为什么改：§4、§6、目标、非目标和 M3 里程碑仍把国内厂商写成插件或备选渠道，与 2026-11-03 的裁决和已落地的 spec 形状（PR #29886、PR #29794）矛盾。
- 风险与回滚：只改一份 ADR 的文字（+22/−9），不动代码、schema 和生成产物，ADR-0030 未改。中继本身还没上线（#29920），ADR 里写的是“已定、计划中”，没有写成“已交付”。回滚就是还原本 PR。
- 先看：状态行里 Amended 一段（列出每处改动，并引用被替换的原文），然后是新增的 §6.1 和 §4 的推送行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:adr-index && pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors && node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs`，三条都应退出 0。
- 需要你做的：这是受管路径 `docs/adr/**`（Tier H），请审阅后手动合并。契约复审 PASS 记录是 6611334981，`Head-sha` 62ac6d3c9c5d58ef2cd3ae974d765a1e3d33cbf9。

席位意见：卡片要求的六处都已落实。fable 契约复审两轮都是 PASS（首轮 3 处措辞精度问题，已在本 head 修正），check-runs 全绿。同意合并。另外，spec 里两处 docblock 仍按旧的 §6 读法引用本 ADR，已另立卡 #29960，等本 PR 合并后再改。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:spec#3 · head `62ac6d3c9c5d58ef2cd3ae974d765a1e3d33cbf9`

- **Shape:** one file, `docs/adr/0012-notification-platform.md`, +22 −9 in two commits. The changes:
  - §4 push backend: `relay (hosted, default) | direct (APNs/FCM, white-label)`;
  - a new §6.1 covering the relay and direct transports, the wire, privacy, air-gap, and what main serves;
  - the Goals, Non-Goals, TL;DR, M3, risk 5 and Decision bullets rewritten;
  - the header's existing `Amended (2026-11-03, #29041)` note extended in place, listing every amended passage with its old wording quoted. `Draft` stays first, and `Superseded by ADR-0030` is kept.
  - No code, schema, generated artifact or changeset.
- **Premise measured:** at `origin/main` `6a4737ab`, the ADR still said the domestic vendors were plugin transports. #29816 had landed through PR #29886, and PR #29794 had merged. The review checked every schema claim against the live tree: the transport union, `{}` reading as relay, the direct transport's `requiredOneOf`, `PushVendorSchema = apns|fcm`, the relay wire, the 401/429 envelopes, and the ID-only payload. The relay is refused at init (`PUSH_RELAY_NOT_SERVED_MESSAGE`, #29920 open).
- **Gates (check-runs at this head):** 45 check-runs, 26 success, 19 skipped (path-filtered), 0 red; `mergeable_state: clean`. One lint job (`Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`) first died on a 20-minute checkout timeout (infra) and passed on its single re-run. Dev sweep at this head: 21 derived, 21 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, all exit 0. Head `cce992bf` had a red `Type Check · consumer gates`, caused by a 20-minute checkout timeout in infra; it did not recur on this head.
- **Contract review:** record 6611334981, `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, rules face, this head, VERDICT PASS. The round-0 record 6610988758 (head `cce992bf`) was also a PASS, with 3 should-fixes, all fixed in `62ac6d3c` and verified by the delta review. One nit remains and is accepted: §6.1 says "the two enums" carry no marker, while a third, non-exported enum (`PushRelayBindingRefusalSchema`) also carries none. That is prose precision only, not worth a round on a governed path.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no (docs only, no spec shape moves)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `skip-changeset` (docs/adr publishes nothing).
- **Accepted deviations:** the order spelled `Clause-②: n/a`. The dev wrote `no`, because `CLAUSE2_VALUES` is yes|no. The `pr_create` body opens with `Fixes #29817` and no signature line, which `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` exempts by name. `Skills-docs: none` (no skills or hand-written docs page names the push relay).
- **Carried:** the docblocks of `PushVendorSchema` (`push-config.zod.ts`) and `push-device.zod.ts` still cite ADR-0012 §6 for the reading that the domestic vendors are alternate channel implementations. Seat 2 declined to fold it into #29820, so the seat filed it as card #29960 (Blocked-by #29952, so the comments change only after the ADR lands).
- **Landing:** Tier H (`check-governed-merges --pr 29952`: GOVERNED, `docs/adr/**` ×1, 31 lines, under the 3000 threshold). Hand-off: `pr_ready`, which makes the relay request the `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, plus `needs-user-decision`. The maintainer merges by hand. The seat does not queue it or arm auto-merge.
